_source.chapter: Weeping Due To Fear Of Allah
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): سَبعةٌ في ظِلِّ عَرشِ اللّهِ عزّ وجلّ يومَ لا ظِلَّ إلّا ظلُّهُ ... ورجُلٌ ذَكرَ اللّهَ عزّ وجلّ خاليا ففاضَتْ عَيناهُ مِن خَشيةِ اللّهِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Seven people will be in the shade of the Throne of Allah, the Exalted, when no shade will avail but His: … and a man who remembered Allah, the Exalted, alone, and his eyes flooded with tears out of fear of Allah.

_source.chapter: Weeping Due To Fear Of Allah
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن خَرَجَ مِن عَينَيهِ مِثلُ الذُّبابِ مِن الدَّمْعِ مِن خَشيَةِ اللّهِ آمَنَهُ اللّهُ بهِ يَومَ الفَزَعِ الأكبَرِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Whoever sheds a tear as small as the size of a fly out of fear of Allah, Allah will grant him safety on the Day of the Great Terror.

_source.chapter: Weeping Due To Fear Of Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): بُكاءُ العُيونِ وخَشْيَةُ القلوبِ مِن رَحْمَةِ اللّهِ تعالى ذِكرُهُ، فإذا وَجَدتُموها فاغتَنِموا الدُّعاءَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The tears in the eyes and the fear in the hearts are part of the mercy of Allah, exalted be His remembrance. When you find them, seize the opportunity for making supplications.

_source.chapter: Weeping Due To Fear Of Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): البُكاءُ مِن خَشيَةِ اللّهِ مِفتاحُ الرَّحمةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Weeping out of fear of Allah is the key to [His] mercy.

_source.chapter: Weeping Due To Fear Of Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): البُكاءُ مِن خَشيةِ اللّهِ يُنيرُ القلبَ، ويَعْصِمُ مِن مُعاوَدَةِ الذَّنبِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Weeping out of fear of Allah illuminates the heart and shields against returning to the sin.

_source.chapter: Weeping Due To Fear Of Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ما مِن قَطرةٍ أحَبَّ إلى اللّهِ عزّ وجلّ مِن قَطْرَتَينِ: قَطرةُ دَمٍ في سبيلِ اللّهِ، وقَطرةُ دَمعَةٍ في سَوادِ اللّيلِ، لا يُريدُ بها عبدٌ إلّا اللّهَ عزّ وجلّ.
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, ‘No drops are more beloved to Allah, the Exalted, than two: a drop of blood [shed] for the sake of Allah, and a teardrop shed by a servant in the darkness of the night solely for Allahs sake.

_source.chapter: Weeping Due To Fear Of Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كُلُّ عَينٍ باكيةٌ يومَ القيامةِ غيرَ ثلاثٍ: عينٌ سَهِرَتْ في سبيلِ اللّهِ، وعينٌ فاضَتْ مِن خَشيَةِ اللّهِ، وعَينٌ غَضّتْ عن مَحارِمِ اللّهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘Every eye will cry on the Day of Judgment except for three: an eye that stayed up [in worship] for the sake of Allah, an eye that filled with tears out of fear of Allah, and an eye that looked away from things prohibited by Allah.

_source.chapter: Weeping Due To Fear Of Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنْ لَم يُجِبْكَ البُكاءُ فَتَباكَ، فإنْ خَرجَ مِنكَ مِثلُ رأسِ الذُّبابِ فَبَخٍ بَخٍ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘If weeping does not come naturally to you, force yourself [to weep], for even if a tear as small as a flys head is shed by you, then congratulations to you.

_source.chapter: Weeping Due To Fear Of Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ما مِن شيءٍ إلّا ولَهُ كَيْلٌ أو وَزنٌ إلّا الدُّموعَ، فإنّ القَطرةَ مِنها تُطْفِئُ بِحاراً مِن نارٍ، وإذا اغْرَوْرَقَتِ العَينُ بمائها لَم يَرْهَقْ وَجهَهُ قَتَرٌ ولا ذِلَّةٌ، فإذا فاضَتْ حَرَّمَهُ اللّهُ على النّارِ، ولَو أنّ باكياً بكى في اُمَّةٍ لَرُحِموا .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Every single thing has a measure or a weight, except for tears; for one drop of them can extinguish seas of Fire. If an eye is filled with tears, the face will never be burdened with neediness or humiliation; and if it floods with tears then Allah will make it unlawful for the Fire to touch it. Indeed, if a teary man cries for a community, they all receive mercy.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مِن عَلاماتِ الشَّقاءِ جُمودُ العَينِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Dryness of the eye is one of the signs of wretchedness.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ما جَفَّتِ الدُّموعُ إلّا لقَسوةِ القلوبِ، وما قَسَتِ القلوبُ إلّا لِكَثْرةِ الذُّنوبِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Tears only dry up as a result of the hardness of the hearts; and the hearts only harden as a result of an abundance of sins.

_source.arabic: عيسى (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنّ الحِكمَةَ نُورُ كُلِّ قَلبٍ.
_source.english: Prophet Jesus (AS) said, ‘Verily wisdom is the light of every heart.

_source.arabic: لُقمانُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ مِن وصيَّتِهِ لابنهِ ـ : يا بُنَيّ ، تَعلَّمِ الحِكمَةَ تَشْرُفْ ؛ فإنَّ الحِكمَةَ تَدُلُّ على الدِّينِ ، وتُشَرِّفُ العَبْدَ على الحُرِّ ، وتَرفَعُ المِسكينَ على الغَنيِّ ، وتُقَدِّمُ الصَّغيرَ على الكَبيرِ.
_source.english: Luqman (AS) said [advising his son], ‘My son, learn wisdom and you will become noble, for verily wisdom directs towards religion, it honours the slave with freedom, it raises the poor above the rich and it precedes the young over the old.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : كَلِمَةُ الحِكمَةِ يَسْمَعُها المؤمنُ خَيرٌ مِن عِبادَةِ سَنةٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘A word of wisdom that the believer hears is better than the worship of one year.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : كادَ الحَكيمُ أنْ يَكونَ نَبيّاً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The wise man is almost a prophet.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحِكمَةُ رَوضَةُ العُقَلاءِ ، ونُزْهَةُ النُّبَلاءِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Wisdom is the garden of the intelligent ones and the amusement of the noble.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحِكمَةُ شَجَرةٌ تَنْبُتُ في القَلبِ ، وتُثْمِرُ على اللِّسانِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Wisdom is a tree that grows in the heart and produces fruit on the tongue.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَن عُرِفَ بالحِكمَةِ لَحَظَتْهُ العُيونُ بالوَقارِ والهَيبةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) has said, ‘The one who is known for [his] wisdom is regarded by the eyes with dignity and awe.

_source.chapter: Wisdom is the Lost Property of the Believer
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحِكمَةُ ضَالّةُ المؤمنِ، فاطْلُبوها ولَو عندَ المُشرِكِ تكونوا أحَقَّ بها وأهلَها.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Wisdom is the lost property of the believer, so seek it even from the polytheist for you will be more deserving and worthier of it [than him].

_source.chapter: Wisdom is the Lost Property of the Believer
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الْحِكْمَةُ ضالَّةُ المُؤْمِنِ، فخُذِ الحِكْمَةَ ولَو مِن أهلِ النِّفاقِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Wisdom is the lost property of the believer, so take wisdom even from the people of hypocrisy.

_source.chapter: What the Wise Man Must Not Do
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لَيس بحَكيمٍ مَن قصَدَ بحاجَتِهِ غَيرَ كَريمٍ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The one who seeks fulfilment of his need from an unwise person is [himself] not a wise person.

_source.chapter: What the Wise Man Must Not Do
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : ليسَ الحَكيمُ مَن لَم يُدارِ مَن لا يَجِدُ بُدّاً مِن مُداراتِهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘A person who does not deal amicably with someone for whom amicableness is the only option is not a wise man.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : أوّلُ الحِكمَةِ تَرْكُ اللَّذّاتِ ، وآخِرُها مَقْتُ الفانِياتِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The opening of wisdom is abandoning the [illicit] pleasures, and the peak of it is to detest the transient things.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مِن الحِكمَةِ أنْ لا تُنازِعَ مَن فَوقَكَ ، ولا تَسْتـَذِلَّ مَن دُونَكَ ، ولا تَتَعاطى ما ليسَ في قُدْرَتِكَ ، ولا يُخالِفَ لِسانُكَ قَلبَكَ ، ولا قَولُكَ فِعلَكَ ، ولا تَتَكلّمَ فيما لا تَعلَمُ ، ولا تَتْرُكَ الأمرَ عِندَ الإقْبالِ وتَطْلُبَهُ عِندَ الإدْبارِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘From among [the matters of] wisdom is to avoid dispute with one who is above you, to not disesteem anyone other than yourself, to not undertake a task which is outside of your capability, to not have your tongue contradict your heart and neither your word [contradict] your action, to not speak of that which you do not know, and to not abandon a matter as it approaches only to pursue it as it retreats.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ وقد سألَهُ أبو بصيرٍ عن قولِ اللّهِ : «ومَن يُؤْتَ الحِكْمَةَ فَقَد اُوتيَ خَيراً كَثيراً»ـ : هِي طاعَةُ اللّهِ ومَعرِفَةُ الإمامِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) when he was asked by Abu Basir regarding the words of Allahs verse, “and he who is given wisdom…” said, ‘It [wisdom] is obedience to Allah and true knowledge of the Imm.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ أيضاً ـ : إنّ الحِكمَةَ المَعرِفَةُ والتَّفَقّهُ في الدِّينِ ، فمَن فَقِهَ مِنكُم فهُو حَكيمٌ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Verily wisdom is inner knowledge and deep understanding of religion, for the one who understands among you is truly the wise man.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : قيلَ لِلُقمانَ : ما يَجْمَعُ مِن حِكْمتِكَ؟ قالَ : لا أسْألُ عَمّا كُفِيتُهُ ، ولا أتَكَلّفُ ما لا يَعْنيني.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘Luqman was asked, what is the crux of your wisdom? He said, ‘I do not ask about that which I know already and I do not burden myself with that which does not concern me.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : رأسُ الحِكمَةِ مَخافَةُ اللّهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The fountainhead of wisdom is the fear of Allah.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : إنّ أشْرَفَ الحَديثِ ذِكْرُ اللّهِ ، ورأسَ الحِكمَةِ طاعَتُهُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily the noblest speech is the remembrance of Allah and the fountainhead of wisdom is His obedience.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : إنّ الرِّفْقَ رأسُ الحِكمَةِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily moderation is the fountainhead of wisdom.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رأسُ الحِكمَةِ لُزومُ الحقِّ وطاعَةُ المُحِقِّ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The fountainhead of wisdom is to be bound to the truth and to obey the one on [the path of] the truth.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : اغْلِبِ الشّهْوَةَ تَكْمُلْ لكَ الحِكمَةُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Conquer your vain desire and your wisdom will be perfected.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لا حِكمَةَ إلّا بعِصْمَةٍ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘There is no wisdom except through inerrancy.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَن زَهِدَ في الدُّنيا أثْبَتَ اللّهُ الحِكمَةَ في قَلبِهِ ، وأنْطَقَ بها لِسانَهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Whoever abstains from worldly pleasures, Allah will establish wisdom in his heart and make it flow from his tongue.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : القَلبُ يَتَحمّلُ الحِكمَةَ عند خُلُوِّ البَطْنِ ، القَلبُ يَمُجُّ الحِكمَةَ عند امْتِلاءِ البَطْنِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The heart bears wisdom when the stomach is empty, and the heart throws out wisdom when the stomach is full.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لاتَجْتَمِعُ الشَّهوَةُ والحِكمَةُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Vain desire and wisdom do not come together.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الغَضَبُ مَمْحَقةٌ لقَلبِ الحكيمِ ، ومَن لم يَمْلِكْ غَضَبَهُ لَم يَمْلِكْ عَقلَهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Anger is a destroyer of the wise mans heart, whoever cannot control his anger cannot control his intellect.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنّ الزَّرعَ يَنْبُتُ في السَّهلِ ولا يَنْبُتُ في الصَّفا ، فكذلكَ الحِكمَةُ تَعْمُرُ في قَلبِ المُتواضِعِ، ولا تَعْمُرُ في قَلبِ المُتَكبِّرِ الجبّارِ؛ لأنَّ اللّهَ جَعلَ التَّواضُعَ آلةَ العَقلِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘Verily a seed grows in soft ground and does not grow on stone, in the same way that wisdom thrives in the heart of the humble and does not thrive in the heart of the proud and haughty, because Allah has made humbleness the instrument of the intellect.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الهاديُّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحِكمَةُ لا تَنْجَعُ في الطِّباعِ الفاسِدَةِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Hadi (AS) said, ‘Wisdom does not avail an immoral character.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَن ثَبتَتْ لَهُ الحِكمَةُ عَرَفَ العِبرَةَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Whoever has wisdom established [in his heart] for him, becomes one who adheres to admonition.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : كَثرةُ النَّظَرِ في الحِكمَةِ تَلْقَحُ العَقلَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Much contemplation on [matters of] wisdom causes the intellect to flourish.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنّ الحُكَماءَ ضَيَّعوا الحِكمَةَ لَمّا وَضَعوها عِند غَيرِ أهْلِها.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily the wise men lost wisdom when they deposited it with those who were unworthy of it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لا تَمْنَحوا الجُهّالَ الحِكمَةَ فتَظْلِموها، ولا تَمْنَعوها أهْلَها فتَظْلِموهُم.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘Do not grant the ignorant ones wisdom for they will not do justice to it, and do not deprive it to those who are worthy of it for you will do injustice to them.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّما سُمِّيَتِ الدُّنيا دُنيا لأنّها أدنى مِن كلِّ شيءٍ ، وسُمِّيَت الآخِرةُ آخِرةً لأنّ فيها الجزاءَ والثوابَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The world has been named dunya because it is lower than every thing, and the Hereafter has been named Akhira because it contains recompense and reward.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): النّاسُ أبناءُ الدنيا ، ولايُلامُ الرجلُ على حُبِّ اُمِّهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘People are the sons of the world, and no man can be blamed for loving his mother.

_source.chapter: The World is the Plantation for the Hereafter
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الدنيا مَزرَعةُ الآخِرَةِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The world is the plantation for the Hereafter.

_source.chapter: The World is the Plantation for the Hereafter
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): بالدنيا تُحرَزُ الآخِرَةُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The Hereafter is secured through the world.

_source.chapter: The World is the Plantation for the Hereafter
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ اللّهَ سبحانَهُ قد جَعَلَ الدنيا لِما بعدَها ، وابتَلى فيها أهلَها ، لِيُعلَمَ أيُّهُم أحسَنُ عَمَلاً ، ولَسنا للدنيا خُلِقنا ، ولا بالسَّعي فيها اُمِرنا .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily Allah, glory be to Him, has made this world for what is after it and has put its inhabitants to trial so that He may know who from among them has the best deeds, and we have not been created for this world, nor have we been commanded to strive for it.

_source.chapter: The World is the Plantation for the Hereafter
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): نِعمَ العَونُ الدنيا علَى الآخِرَةِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘The world is the best aid for the Hereafter.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الدنيا ملعونةٌ وملعونٌ ما فيها ، إلّا ما ابتُغِيَ به وَجهُ اللّهِ عزّ وجلّ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The world is cursed along with what is in it, except that through which the pleasure of Allah is sought.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدنيا دُنياءانِ: دنيا بلاغٍ ودنيا ملعونةٌ.
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, ‘The world is of two types: that which causes one to attain [success in the Hereafter] and that which is cursed.

_source.chapter: Taking Only What is Necessary from the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لرجلٍ شكا إليه الحاجةَ ـ: اِعلَم أنّ كلَّ شيءٍ تُصيبُهُ مِن الدنيا فوقَ قُوتِكَ فإنّما أنتَ فيهِ خازنٌ لِغيرِكَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said to a man who complained regarding his needs, ‘Know that everything that you attain in this world that supersedes your required provision, you are considered to be its treasurer for someone else.

_source.chapter: Taking Only What is Necessary from the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا تَسألُوا فيها فوقَ الكَفافِ، ولا تَطلُبُوا منها أكثرَ مِن البلاغِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said [regarding the world], ‘Do not ask in it for what is more than a sufficient means of living and do not seek from it more than what you need.

_source.chapter: Taking Only What is Necessary from the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدنيا دارُ المُنافِقينَ ولَيست بدارِ المُتّقينَ ، فَليكُنْ حظُّكَ مِن الدنيا قِوامَ صُلْبِكَ ، وإمساكَ نَفْسِكَ ، والتَزَوّدَ لمَعادِكَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The world is the abode of the hypocrites and it is not the abode of the pious ones, so take from the world enough to keep your body strong, to keep yourself alive and to gain provision for your Resurrection.

_source.chapter: Taking Only What is Necessary from the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ما منزلةُ الدنيا مِن نفسي إلّا بمنزلةِ الميتةِ، إذا اضطُرِرتُ إليها أكَلتُ مِنها.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The status of this world according to me is just as a dead body, where I will only eat from it if I am compelled to do so.

_source.chapter: The World With Regards to One Who Has Abandoned it
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أوحَى اللّهُ تَبارَكَ وَتَعالى إلى الدنيا: اِخْدِمي مَن خَدَمَنِي ، وأتْعِبي مَن خَدَمَكِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily Allah revealed to the world, ‘Tire and wear out the one who serves you, and serve the one who rejects you.

_source.chapter: The World With Regards to One Who Has Abandoned it
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدنيا لِمَن تَرَكَها والآخرةُ لِمَن طَلَبَها .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The world is for the one who abandons it and the Hereafter is for the one who seeks it.

_source.chapter: The World With Regards to One Who Has Abandoned it
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَثَلُ الدنيا كَظِلِّكَ؛ إن وَقَفتَ وَقَفَ ، وإن طَلَبتَهُ بَعُدَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The example of this world is like your shadow for if you stand still, it stands still and if you chase it, it distances itself.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا تَسُبُّوا الدنيا فَنِعمَتْ مَطِيَّةُ المؤمنِ ، فعلَيها يَبلُغُ الخيرَ وبها يَنجو مِن الشرِّ ، إنّهُ إذا قالَ العبدُ: لَعَنَ اللّهُ الدنيا قالَتِ الدُّنيا: لَعَنَ اللّهُ أعصانا لِرَبِّهِ!
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Do not insult the world for it is the best mount for the believer, because by means of it he attains good and through it he is saved from evil. If a servant [of Allah] says: “May Allah curse the world”, the world replies: “May Allah curse the most disobedient one towards his Lord from among us!”.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أيُّها الذامُّ للدنيا المُغتَرُّ بِغُرورِها المَخدُوعُ بِأباطيلِها ، أتَغتَرُّ بالدنيا ثُمّ تَذُمُّها؟! أنتَ المُتَجرِّمُ علَيها أم هي المُتجَرِّمَةُ علَيكَ؟! متى استَهوَتْكَ أم متى غَرَّتكَ؟! ... إنَّ الدنيا دارُ صِدقٍ لِمَن صَدَقَها ، ودارُ عافيةٍ لِمَن فَهِمَ عنها ، ودارُ غِنىً لِمَن تَزَوَّدَ مِنها.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘O you who insult the world, who have been deceived by its deceit and cheated by its falsities, do you covet the world and then insult it? Should you accuse it or should it accuse you? When did it bewilder it or deceive you?!… Verily the world is an abode of truth for he who is truthful to it, an abode of wellbeing for he who understands it, and an abode of riches for he who collects provision from it [for the next world].

_source.chapter: Characteristics of the Condemned Aspect of the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدنيا سُوقُ الخُسرانِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The world is the marketplace of the losers.

_source.chapter: Characteristics of the Condemned Aspect of the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدنيا مَصرَعُ العقولِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The world is the ground of ruin for the intellects.

_source.chapter: Characteristics of the Condemned Aspect of the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدنيا مَعدِنُ الشرِّ ومحلُّ الغُرورِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The world is the origin of evil and the place of deceit.

_source.chapter: Characteristics of the Condemned Aspect of the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدنيا مَزرعةُ الشَّرِّ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The world is a plantation of evil.

_source.chapter: Characteristics of the Condemned Aspect of the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدنيا تُذِلُّ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The world lowers and abases [mankind].

_source.chapter: Love of the World is the Fountainhead of Every Mistake
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أكبَرُ الكبائرِ حُبُّ الدنيا.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The gravest of the grave sins is love of the world.

_source.chapter: Love of the World is the Fountainhead of Every Mistake
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): حُبُّ الدنيا أصلُ كلِّ مَعصيَةٍ وأوّلُ كُلِّ ذَنبٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Love of the world is the origin of every act of disobedience and the beginning of every sin.

_source.chapter: Love of the World is the Fountainhead of Every Mistake
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لَيْسَ مِن حُبِّ الدنيا طَلَبُ ما يُصْلِحُكَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Searching for what will improve you is not considered love of the world.

_source.chapter: Love of the World is the Fountainhead of Every Mistake
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): رأسُ كلِّ خطيئةٍ حُبُّ الدنيا.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The fountainhead of every mistake is love of the world.

_source.chapter: The Effects of Love of the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): حُبُّ الدنيا يُفسِدُ العقلَ، وَيُصِمُّ القلبَ عن سَماعِ الحكمةِ ، ويوجِبُ أليمَ العِقابِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Love of the world corrupts the intellect, it deafens the heart from hearing wisdom and it brings about a painful chastisement.

_source.chapter: The Effects of Love of the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): حُبُّ الدنيا يُوجِب الطَّمَعَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Love of the world engenders greed.

_source.chapter: The Effects of Love of the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن تَعَلَّقَ قلبُهُ بالدنيا تَعَلَّقَ قلبُهُ بثلاثِ خصالٍ: هَمٍّ لا يَفنى ، وأمَلٍ لا يُدرَكُ ، ورجاءٍ لا يُنالُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The one who attaches his heart to the world has attached his heart to three things, endless worry, false expectation and an unattainable hope.

_source.chapter: The Effects of Love of the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن كَثُرَ اشتِباكُهُ بالدنيا كانَ أشَدَّ لحَسرَتِهِ عند فِراقِها .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Whoever increasingly becomes ensnared by the world, his distress will be greater when separating from it.

_source.chapter: The World from the Viewpoint of Imam Ali (AS)
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): واللّهِ لَدُنياكُم هذهِ أهوَنُ في عَينِي مِن عِرَاقِ خِنزيرٍ في يَدِ مَجذومٍ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘By Allah, this world of yours is worse in my eyes than the sweat of a pig in the palm of a leper.
_source.chapter_ar: الدُّنيا مِن وجهَةِ نَظَرِ الإمام عَلِيٍّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ)

_source.chapter: The World from the Viewpoint of Imam Ali (AS)
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): دُنياكُم هذِهِ أزهَدُ عِندي مِن عَفْطَةِ عَنزٍ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘This world of yours is more forsaken to me than the sneezing of a goat.
_source.chapter_ar: الدُّنيا مِن وجهَةِ نَظَرِ الإمام عَلِيٍّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ)

_source.chapter: The World from the Viewpoint of Imam Ali (AS)
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لَدُنياكُم أهوَنُ عِندي مِن وَرَقَةٍ (في) فِي جَرادَةٍ تَقضِمُها ، ... ما لِعَلِيّ ونعيمٍ يَفْنى.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily your world to me is more worthless than a leaf being gnawed at in the mouth of a locust. What has Ali got to do with perishable things?!
_source.chapter_ar: الدُّنيا مِن وجهَةِ نَظَرِ الإمام عَلِيٍّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ)
_source.cited_from: Sharhe Nahj al-Balagha li Ibn Abi al-Hadid, volume:11, p. 246

_source.chapter: The World from the Viewpoint of Imam Ali (AS)
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إليكِ عَنِّي يا دنيا ، فحَبلُكِ على غارِبِكِ ، قدِ انسَلَلتُ مِن مَخالِبِكِ ، وأفلَتُّ مِن حَبائلِكِ ، واجتَنَبتُ الذَّهابَ في مداحِضِكِ....
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Get away from me, O World! Your rein is on your own shoulders as I have released myself from your ditches, removed myself from your snares and avoided walking into your slippery places.
_source.chapter_ar: الدُّنيا مِن وجهَةِ نَظَرِ الإمام عَلِيٍّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ)

_source.chapter: The World from the Viewpoint of Imam Ali (AS)
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اُحَذِّرُكُمُ الدنيا ، فإنّها حُلوَةٌ خَضِرَةٌ حُفَّتْ بِالشَّهَواتِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Beware of the world, for verily it appears sweet and green, surrounded by carnal and base desires.
_source.chapter_ar: الدُّنيا مِن وجهَةِ نَظَرِ الإمام عَلِيٍّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ)

_source.chapter: The World from the Viewpoint of Imam Ali (AS)
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إحذَرُوا الدنيا ، فإنَّ في حلالِها حِساب[ا] ، وفي حَرامِها عقاب[ا] ، وأوّلُها عَناءٌ ، وآخِرُها فَناءٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Beware of the world, for verily with regards to its lawful things there is accountability and with regards to its unlawful things there is punishment, its beginning is hardship and its end is annihilation.
_source.chapter_ar: الدُّنيا مِن وجهَةِ نَظَرِ الإمام عَلِيٍّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ)

_source.chapter: The World from the Viewpoint of Imam Ali (AS)
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اِحذَروا هَذِهِ الدنيا الخَدَّاعةَ الغَدّارةَ ، التي قد تَزَيّنَتْ بِحُلِيِّها ، وفَتَنَتْ بِغُرورِها... فأصبَحَتْ كالعَروسِ المَجْلُوَّةِ ، والعُيونُ إلَيها ناظِرَةٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Beware of this deceptive and deceitful world that has been beautified by its ornaments and has seduced through its delusions… such that it has become like an unveiled bride upon whom everyones eyes are gazing.
_source.chapter_ar: الدُّنيا مِن وجهَةِ نَظَرِ الإمام عَلِيٍّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ)

_source.chapter: The World from the Viewpoint of Imam Ali (AS)
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إحذَروا الدنيا ، فإنّها غَدّارةٌ غَرّارةٌ خَدُوعٌ ، مُعطِيَةٌ مَنوعٌ ، مُلبِسةٌ نَزُوعٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Beware of the world, for verily it is deceptive, delusive and deceitful, it is a giver that deprives, and one who clothes yet leaves you naked.
_source.chapter_ar: الدُّنيا مِن وجهَةِ نَظَرِ الإمام عَلِيٍّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ)

_source.chapter: The World from the Viewpoint of Imam Ali (AS)
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اِحذَروا الدنيا ، فإنّها عَدُوّةُ أولياءِ اللّهِ ، وعَدُوّةُ أعدائهِ ، أمّا أولياؤهُ فَغَمَّتهُم ، وأمّا أعداؤهُ فَغَرَّتهُم .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Beware of the world, for verily it is the enemy of the friends of Allah and the enemy of His enemies too. As for the friends of Allah, it fills them with grief and as for Allahs enemies, it deludes them.
_source.chapter_ar: الدُّنيا مِن وجهَةِ نَظَرِ الإمام عَلِيٍّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ)

_source.chapter: Warning against the Deception of the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ألا وإنّ الدنيا دارٌ غَرّارةٌ خَدّاعةٌ ، تَنكِحُ في كلِّ يومٍ بَعْلاً ، وتَقتُلُ في كلِّ ليلةٍ أهلاً ، وتُفَرِّقُ في كلِّ ساعةٍ شَملاً .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily the world is a house of deception and deceit, it takes a spouse everyday, kills a family every night and splits up a group every hour.

_source.chapter: Warning against the Deception of the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): فلا يَغُرَّنَّكُم كَثرَةُ ما يُعجِبُكُم فيها لِقِلَّةِ ما يَصحَبُكُم مِنها .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Do not allow the abundance of what amazes you in it to deceive you because it will be only a little that you take from it.

_source.chapter: Warning against the Deception of the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): غَرّارةٌ غَرورٌ ما فيها ، فانيةٌ فانٍ مَن علَيها، لا خَيرَ في شيءٍ مِن أزوادِها إلّا التَّقوى .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘It is deceitful, and all that is in it is deceptive. It is perishable and all that is on it will perish. There is no good in any of its provisions except in piety and Godwariness.

_source.chapter: Verily the World Deceives the Ignorant
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): غُرّي يا دنيا مَن جَهِلَ حِيَلَكِ وخَفِيَ علَيهِ حبائلُ كَيدِكِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘O World, deceive those who are ignorant of your tricks and who are unaware of the snares of your sly deceptions.

_source.chapter: Verily the World Deceives the Ignorant
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): العاجِلَةُ غُرورُ الحَمقى .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The transient world is the booty of the foolish.

_source.chapter: Verily the World Deceives the Ignorant
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الفَرَحُ بالدُّنيا حُمقٌ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Being happy with the world is foolishness.

_source.chapter: Warning against Being Satisfied with the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في قولهِ تعالى: «وكانَ تَحتَهُ كَنْزٌ لَهُما»ـ: كانَ ذلكَ الكنزُ لَوحاً مِن ذهبٍ فيه مَكتوبٌ: ... عَجِبتُ لِمَن يَرَى الدنيا وتَصَرُّفَ أهلِها حالاً بعدَ حالٍ كيفَ يَطمئنُّ إلَيها؟!
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) with regards to Allahs verse: “Under it there was a treasure belonging to them”, said, ‘that (the treasure) was a golden tablet upon which was written…: I wonder at those who see the world and the fluctuating states that people experience, how can they be satisfied with it?

_source.chapter: Warning against Being Satisfied with the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اُنظُرُوا إلى الدنيا نَظَرَ الزاهدِينَ فيها ، فإنّها عَن قليلٍ تُزيلُ الساكنَ ، وتَفجَعُ المُترَفَ فلا تَغُرَّنّكُم كَثرَةُ ما يُعجِبُكُم فيها لِقلَّةِ ما يَصحَبُكُم مِنها.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Look at the world through the eyes of those who have renounced it, for verily its inhabitants are quick to depart it and its opulence inflicts distress. So do not allow the abundance of what amazes you therein to deceive you, for it is but a little that you will take with you thereof.

_source.chapter: Warning against Being Satisfied with the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اُنظُرْ إلى الدنيا نَظَرَ الزاهدِ المُفارقِ ، ولا تَنظُرْ إلَيها نَظَرَ العاشِقِ الوامِقِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘View the world through the eyes of one who has renounced it and separated from it, and do not view it through the eyes of one who loves it passionately and tenderly.

_source.chapter: Warning against Being Satisfied with the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إن كانتِ الدنيا فانيَةً فالطُّمأنينَةُ إلَيها لِماذا؟!
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘If this world is transient, then why be satisfied with it?

_source.chapter: The Danger of Preferring the World [over the Hereafter]
_source.arabic: لقمانُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لابنِهِ وهو يَعِظُهُ ـ: بِعْ دُنياكَ بِآخِرَتِكَ تَربَحْهُما جميعاً ، ولا تَبِعْ آخِرَتَكَ بدُنياكَ تَخْسَرهما جميعاً .
_source.english: Luqman (AS) said in counsel to his son, ‘Sell your world for your Hereafter and you will attain both of them, but do not sell your Hereafter for your world for you will lose them both.

_source.chapter: The Danger of Preferring the World [over the Hereafter]
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن عَبَدَ الدنيا وآثَرَها على الآخرةِ استَوخَمَ العاقِبةَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The one who worships the world and prefers it over the Hereafter seeks an unhealthy outcome.

_source.chapter: The Danger of Preferring the World [over the Hereafter]
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَترُكُ الناسُ شيئاً مِن أمرِ دينِهِم لاستِصلاحِ دُنياهُم إلّا فَتَحَ اللّهُ علَيهِم ما هو أضَرُّ مِنهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘No sooner do people abandon an aspect of their religion in order to advance their worldly affairs than Allah will inflict them with something that is more detrimental than that.

_source.chapter: The World is the Prison of the Believer
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الدنيا لا تَصفو لِمُؤمنٍ ، كيفَ وهِي سِجنُهُ وبلاؤهُ؟!
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The world is not trouble-free for the believer, how can it be when it is his prison and his trial?

_source.chapter: The World is the Prison of the Believer
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدنيا سِجنُ المؤمنِ والقَبرُ حِصنُهُ والجنّةُ مَأواهُ ، والدنيا جَنَّةُ الكافِرِ والقبرُ سِجنُهُ والنارُ مَأواهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The world is the prison of the believer, the grave is his fortress and Paradise is his final abode. The world is the Paradise of the disbeliever, the grave is his prison and the Fire is his final abode.

_source.chapter: The Danger of Making Worldly Affairs Ones Greatest Concern
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) مَن كانَتِ الدنيا أكبرَ هَمِّهِ طالَ شَقاؤهُ وغَمُّهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The one who regards the worldly affairs as his greatest concern, his grief and distress are lengthened.

_source.chapter: The Danger of Making Worldly Affairs Ones Greatest Concern
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن أصبَحَ وأمسى والدنيا أكبَرُ هَمِّهِ جَعَلَ اللّهُ تعالى الفَقرَ بينَ عَينَيهِ وشَتَّتَ أمرَهُ ولم يَنَلْ مِن الدنيا إلّا ما قَسَمَ اللّهُ له ، ومَن أصبَحَ وأمسى والآخرةُ أكبَرُ هَمِّهِ جَعَلَ اللّهُ تعالى الغِنى في قلبِهِ وجَمَعَ لَهُ أمرَهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The person who wakes up in the morning and retires at night having worldly affairs as his greatest concern, Allah places poverty between his eyes, scatters his affairs, and he will not take from this world except what Allah has apportioned for him. As for the one who wakes up in the morning and retires at night having the Hereafter as his greatest concern, Allah places needlessness in his heart and brings together his affairs for him.

_source.chapter: The Lowliness of the World in Allahs Eyes
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): يقولُ اللّهُ: لولا عَبدي المؤمنُ لَعَصَّبْتُ رأسَ الكافِرِ بعِصابةٍ مِن جَوهَرٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Allah says, ‘Were it not for My believing servant, I would have tied a headband of jewels around the head of the disbeliever.

_source.chapter: The Lowliness of the World in Allahs Eyes
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لو أنّ الدنيا كانَت تَعدِلُ عند اللّهِ عزّوجلّ جَناحَ بَعوضَةٍ ما سَقَى الكافِرَ والفاجرَ مِنها شَربَةً مِن ماءٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘If the world was worth the same as the wing of a mosquito in Allahs eyes, the disbeliever and the insolent person would never get to drink a sip of water from it.

_source.chapter: The Lowliness of the World in Allahs Eyes
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مِن هَوانِ الدنيا على اللّهِ أنّهُ لا يُعصى إلّا فيها ، ولا يُنالُ ما عندَهُ إلّا بتَركِها.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The lowliness of the world in Allahs eyes can be seen by the fact that He is not disobeyed except in it, and what is with Him cannot be attained except by abandoning the world.

_source.chapter: The Lowliness of the World in Allahs Eyes
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسينُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ مِن هَوانِ الدنيا على اللّه تعالى أنَّ رَأسَ يحيى بنِ زكريّا اُهدِيَ إلى بَغِيٍّ مِن بَغايا بني إسرائيلَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Husayn (AS) said, ‘Verily the lowliness of this world in Allahs eyes can be seen by the fact that the head of Prophet John, son of Prophet Zacharias was gifted to a whore from the whores of the Israelites.

_source.chapter: The Difference between the World and the Hereafter
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن أحَبَّ دُنياهُ أضَرَّ بآخرَتِهِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘He who loves his world has harmed his Hereafter.

_source.chapter: The Difference between the World and the Hereafter
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ الدنيا والآخِرَةَ عَدُوّانِ مُتَفاوِتانِ ، وسَبيلانِ مُختَلِفانِ ، فَمَن أحَبَّ الدنيا وتَولاَّها أبغضَ الآخِرَةَ وعاداها ، وهُما بمَنزِلَةِ المَشرِقِ والمَغرِبِ وماشٍ بَينَهُما ، كُلَّما قَرُبَ مِن واحدٍ بَعُدَ مِنَ الآخَرِ ، وهُما بَعدُ ضَرَّتانِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily the world and the Hereafter are two opposing enemies and two different paths, so whoever loves and befriends the world has despised the Hereafter and has made it his enemy. They [the world and the Hereafter] are like the east and the west and whoever walks between them, however much he gets closer to one, he distances himself from the other. After all, they are like two wives of the same husband.

_source.chapter: The Difference between the World and the Hereafter
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَرارةُ الدنيا حَلاوةُ الآخِرَةِ ، وحَلاوَةُ الدنيا مَرارَةُ الآخِرَةِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The bitterness of the world is the sweetness of the Hereafter, and the sweetness of the world is the bitterness of the Hereafter.

_source.chapter: The Difference between the World and the Hereafter
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): طَلَبُ الجمعِ بينَ الدنيا والآخِرةِ مِن خِداعِ النَّفْسِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Seeking to bring together this world and the next is from the deception of the soul.

_source.chapter: The Difference between the World and the Hereafter
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ما التَذَّ أحدٌ مِنَ الدنيا لَذَّةً إلّا كانتْ لَهُ يومَ القيامةِ غُصّةً.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘No one tastes a worldly pleasure except that he will face a torment on the Day of Resurrection.

_source.chapter: The Difference between the World and the Hereafter
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ثَروَةُ الدنيا فَقرُ الآخِرَةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The wealth of this world is the poverty of the Hereafter.

_source.chapter: The Difference between the World and the Hereafter
_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): واللّهِ ما الدُّنيا والآخِرَةُ إلّا كَكِفَّتَيِ المِيزانِ ، فأيُّهما رَجَحَ ذَهَبَ بالآخَرِ.
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, ‘By Allah, this world and the next are naught but two scales of a balance, so whichever scale is weightier, it will overpower the other.

_source.chapter: The Difference between the World and the Hereafter
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): آخِرُ نبيٍّ يَدخُلُ الجنّةَ سُليمانُ بنُ داوود (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ، وذلك لِما اُعطِيَ في الدنيا.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The last prophet to enter paradise will be Solomon [Prophet Solomon (AS) is known as Sulayman in the Arabic tradition (ed.)] son of David (AS) due to what he was given in this world.

_source.chapter: Combining the World and the Hereafter
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الحَرثُ حَرثانِ: فحَرثُ الدنيا المالُ والبَنونُ، وحَرثُ الآخرةِ الباقياتُ الصالحاتُ ، وقد يَجمَعُهُم اللّهُ عزّوجلّ لأقوامٍ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Wealth and children are the cultivation of the world and righteous deeds are the cultivation of the Hereafter, and sometimes Allah combines the two for people.

_source.chapter: Combining the World and the Hereafter
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إن جَعَلتَ دِينَكَ تَبَعاً لدُنياكَ أهلَكتَ دينَكَ ودُنياكَ وكُنتَ في الآخرةِ مِن الخاسِرينَ ، إن جَعَلتَ دُنياكَ تَبَعاً لِدينِكَ أحرَزْتَ دِينَكَ ودُنياكَ وكُنتَ في الآخرةِ مِن الفائزينَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘If you make your religion secondary to your worldly affairs, you have destroyed both your religion and your worldly affairs, and thus you will be among the losers in the Hereafter. But if you make your worldly affairs secondary to your religion, you have safeguarded your religion and your worldly affairs and you will be among the victorious ones in the Hereafter.

_source.chapter: Combining the World and the Hereafter
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إجعَلوا لِأنفُسِكُم حظّاً مِن الدنيا بِإعطائها ما تَشتَهي مِن الحلالِ وما لا يَثلِمُ المُروّةَ وما لا سَرَفَ فيهِ ، واستَعِينوا بذلكَ على اُمورِ الدِّينِ ، فإنّهُ رُوِيَ: ليسَ مِنّا مَن تَرَكَ دُنياهُ لدِينِهِ ، أو تَرَكَ دِينَهُ لِدُنياهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘Allocate for yourselves a portion of the world by taking from it that which is lawful of what you desire, and that which does not breach the honourable virtues and that wherein there is no extravagance. And in this way, use it to assist [and improve] the matters of religion, for it has been narrated that, ‘The one who abandons their worldly affairs for their religion is not from us, and neither is the one who abandons their religion for their worldly affairs.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَثَلُ الدنيا كَظِلِّكَ ؛ إن وَقَفتَ وَقَفَ ، وإن طَلَبتَهُ بَعُدَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The parable of this world is like your shadow - if you stop, it stands still, and if you chase it, it distances itself from you.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَثَلُ الدنيا مَثَلُ الحَيّةِ ؛ مَسُّها لَيِّنٌ وفي جَوفِها السُّمُّ القاتِلُ ، يَحذَرُها الرِّجالُ ذَوُو العُقولِ ، ويَهوِي إلَيها الصِّبيانُ بأيديهِم .
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘The parable of this world is like that of a snake, it is soft to touch but it contains a deadly poison. Men of intellect are cautious whereas children extend their arms towards it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَثَلُ الدنيا مَثَلُ ماءِ البحرِ؛ كُلَّما شَرِبَ مِنهُ العَطشانُ ازدادَ عَطَشاً حتّى يَقتُلَهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘The parable of this world is that of sea water, however much the thirsty man drinks from it, his thirst intensifies until it kills him.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): تَمَثَّلَتِ الدنيا للمسيحِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) في صُورةِ امرأةٍ زَرْقاءَ ، فقالَ لَها: كَم تَزَوَّجتِ؟ فقالَت: كثيراً ، قالَ: فَكُلٌّ طَلَّقَكِ؟ قالَت: لا ، بَل كُلاًّ قَتَلتُ ، قالَ المسيحُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): فَوَيحٌ لأزواجِكِ الباقينَ ، كيفَ لا يَعتَبِروُنَ بالماضينَ ؟!
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘The world was embodied to Jesus (AS) in the form of a blue-eyed woman, and he said to her, ‘How many have you married? she said, ‘Lots, so he asked, ‘So all of them divorced you?, she replied, ‘No, rather I killed all of them, then Jesus (AS) said, ‘Woe upon your current spouses, for how do they not take a lesson from your previous ones?!

_source.arabic: رُوِيَ أنّ جَبرئيلَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) قالَ لِنوحٍ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يا أطوَلَ الأنبياءِ عُمراً ، كيفَ وَجَدتَ الدنيا؟ قال: كَدارٍ لَها بابانِ دَخَلتُ مِن أحَدِهما وخَرَجتُ مِنَ الآخَرِ.
_source.english: It is narrated in Tanbih al-Khawatir that the archangel Gabriel (AS) said to Prophet Noah (AS), ‘O prophet who has lived for the longest number of years, how did you find this world? he replied, ‘Like a house which has two doors, I entered through one and then left through the other.

_source.arabic: عيسى (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّما الدنيا قَنطَرةٌ ، فاعبُرُوها ولا تَعمُروها.
_source.english: Prophet Jesus (AS) said, ‘Verily this world is a bridge, so cross over it but do not build on it.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ما الدنيا في الآخِرَةِ إلاّ مِثلُ مايَجعَلُ أحدُكُم إصبَعَهُ في اليَمِّ فليَنظُرْ بِمَ يَرجِعُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘This world when compared to the Hereafter is just as if one of you dips his finger in the sea and sees what he comes out with.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الدنيا ساعةٌ فاجعَلوها طاعةً .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The world is an hour [long] so make it one of obedience.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدنيا مُنتَقِلَةٌ فانيةٌ ، إن بَقِيَتْ لَكَ لَم تَبقَ لَها .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The world is a transitory and mobile thing, even if it waits for you, do not wait for it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أيّها الناسُ ، إنّما الدنيا دارُ مَجازٍ والآخِرةُ دارُ قَرارٍ ، فخُذوا مِن مَمَرِّكُم لِمَقَرِّكُم .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘O people, verily the world is a passage while the Hereafter is a permanent abode, so take [as much as you can] from the passage for the permanent abode.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدنيا دارُ مَمَرٍّ لا دارُ مَقَرٍّ ، والناسُ فيها رجُلانِ: رجلٌ باعَ فيها نفسَهُ فأوبَقَها ، ورَجُلٌ ابتاعَ نفسَهُ فَأعتَقَها .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘This world is a transitory place and not a permanent one. The people therein are of two types, the man who has sold his self [to his passions] and thus ruined it, and the man who has purchased his self [by control against his passions] and thus freed it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ عليه السلام : أنزِلِ الدنيا كمَنزِلٍ نَزَلتَهُ ثُمّ ارتَحَلتَ عَنهُ ، أو كمالٍ وَجَدتَهُ في مَنامِكَ فاستَيقَظتَ ولَيس مَعكَ مِنهُ شيءٌ ، إنّي (إنّما) ضَرَبتُ لكَ هذا مَثَلاً لأنّها عِندَ أهلِ اللُبِّ والعِلمِ باللّه كَفَيْءِ الظِّلالِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘[Consider] your sojourn in this world just as a house that you stayed in and [soon] departed from, or an object of perfection that you witnessed in a dream then you awoke and not a thing from it remained with you. I have given you this parable because this world, according to the people of intellect and knowledge of Allah, is just as the shadow in the shade.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ عليه السلام : إنّ الدنيا عِندَ العُلَماءِ مِثلُ الظِلِّ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘The world in the eyes of the learned ones is like a shadow.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ عليه السلام : إنّ لُقمانَ قالَ لاِبنِهِ : ... إنّ الدنيا بحرٌ عميقٌ ، قد غَرِقَ فيها عالَمٌ كثيرٌ ، فلتَكُنْ سَفينتُكَ فيها تَقوَى اللّه ، وحَشوُها الإيمانُ وشِراعُها التوكُّلُ ، وقَيِّمُها العقلُ ، ودليلُها العِلمُ ، وسُكّانُها الصَّبرُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘Luqman said to his son:…the world is a deep ocean in which many worlds have already drowned, so make Godwariness your boat, faith its content, trust in Allah its sail, reason its custodian, knowledge its guide and patience its inhabitants.

_source.chapter: The World is a Place Surrounded by Trials
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): دارٌ بالبلاءِ مَحفوفَةٌ ، وبالغَدْرِ مَعروفَةٌ ، لا تَدومُ أحوالُها ، ولا يَسلَمُ نُزّالُها ، أحوالٌ مُختَلِفةٌ ، تاراتٌ مُتَصَرِّفَةٌ ، العَيشُ فيها مَذمومٌ ، والأمانُ مِنها مَعدومٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘[The world] is a house surrounded by trials, well-known for treachery, whose conditions do not last, whose inhabitants do not remain safe, its states are variable, its ways are changing, life in it is shameful and security in it is non-existent.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أفضَلُ النّاسِ مَن عَشِقَ العِبادَةَ فَعانَقَها، وأحَبَّها بقَلبِهِ، وباشَرَها بِجَسَدِهِ، وتَفرَّغَ لَها، فَهُو لا يُبالي عَلى ما أصبَحَ مِنَ الدُّنيا: عَلى عُسرٍ أم عَلى يُسرٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The best of people is he who longs for worship and embraces it, loves it with his heart, throws himself into it with his whole body, and devotes himself exclusively to it, such that he is not concerned in what worldly state he wakes up in the morning: in difficulty or in ease.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): كَفى بِالعِبادَةِ شُغلاً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Worship suffices as an occupation.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): يَقولُ رَبُّكُم: يَابنَ آدَمَ، تَفَرَّغْ لِعِبادَتي أملَأُ قَلبَكَ غِنىً و أملَأُ يَدَيكَ رِزقاً. يَابنَ آدمَ، لا تَباعَدْ مِنّي فأملَأَ قَلبَكَ فَقراً وأملَأَ يَدَيكَ شُغلاً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Your Lord addresses you, saying, ‘O son of Adam! Devote yourself exclusively to My worship and I will fill your heart with wealth and your hands with ready sustenance. O son of Adam! Do not distance yourself from Me or I will fill your heart with poverty and your hands with work [to preoccupy you].

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا أحَبَّ اللّهُ عَبداً ألهَمَهُ حُسنَ العِبادَةِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘When Allah loves a servant He inspires him to carry out the best forms of worship.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): العُبوديَّةُ خَمسَةُ أشياءَ: خَلاءُ البَطنِ، وَقِراءةُ القرآنِ، وقِيامُ اللَّيلِ، والتَّضَرُّعُ عِندَ الصُّبحِ، والبُكاءُ مِن خَشيَةِ اللّهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Adoration [of Allah] consists of five things: keeping the stomach empty, reading the Quran, performing the night prayer, imploring Allah at dawn, and crying much from fear of Allah.

_source.chapter: The Role of Understanding and Conviction in Worship
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا عِبادَةَ إلّا بِيَقينٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘There is no use to worship without conviction.

_source.chapter: The Role of Understanding and Conviction in Worship
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): اُعبُدِ اللّهَ كَأنَّكَ تَراهُ، فَإن لَم تَكُن تَراهُ، فَإنَّهُ يَراكَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Worship Allah as if you see Him, for although you may not see Him, indeed He sees you.

_source.chapter: The Role of Understanding and Conviction in Worship
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا خَيرَ في عِبادَةٍ ليسَ فيها تَفَقُّهٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Worship without understanding is no good.

_source.chapter: The Role of Understanding and Conviction in Worship
_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينَ العابدينُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا عِبادَةَ إلّا بالتَفَقُّهِ.
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, ‘There is no point to worship unless performed with understanding.

_source.arabic: عيسى (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لِرجُلٍ ـ: ما تَصنَعُ ؟ قالَ: أتَعَبَّدُ، قالَ: فمَن يَعودُ علَيكَ ؟ قالَ: أخي، قالَ: أخوكَ أعبَدُ مِنكَ .
_source.english: Prophet Jesus (AS) asked a man, ‘What are you doing? The man replied, ‘I am worshipping. So he asked, ‘Then who is it that supports you [financially]? He replied, ‘My brother, to which Prophet Jesus (AS) said, ‘Your brother is a better worshipper than you.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): العِبادَةُ عَشرَةُ أجزاءٍ، تِسعَةُ أجزاءٍ في طَلَبِ الحَلالِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Worship consists of ten parts, nine of which are to do with earning a lawful living.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): نَظَرُ الوَلَدِ إلى والِدَيهِ حُبّاً لَهُما عِبادَةٌ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘A sons looking at his parents with love is a form of worship [of Allah].

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): النَّظَرُ إلَى العالِمِ عِبادَةٌ، والنَّظَرُ إلَى الإمامِ المُقسِطِ عِبادَةٌ، وَالنَّظَرُ إلَى الوالِدَينِ بِرَأفَةٍ وَرحمَةٍ عِبادَةٌ، وَالنَّظَرُ إلى أخٍ تَوَدُّهُ في اللّهِ عَزَّوجلَّ عِبادَةٌ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Looking at [the face of] a scholar is worship, looking at [the face of] a just Imam is worship, looking at ones parents with kindness and mercy is worship, and looking at the face of a brother whom you love for the sake of Allah is worship.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): حُسنُ الظَّنِّ باللّهِ مِن عِبادَةِ اللّهِ تعالى .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Entertaining the best opinion about Allah is a form of worship of Allah, most High.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): التَّفَكُّرُ في مَلَكوتِ السّماواتِ والأرضِ عِبادَةُ المُخلِصينَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Pondering about the dominion of the heavens and the earth is the worship of the sincere ones.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ مِنَ العِبادَةِ لِينَ الكَلامِ وإفشاءَ السَّلامِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily part of worship is to talk to people in a gentle manner and to spread the greeting of peace among them.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ فَوقَ كلِّ عِبادَةٍ عِبادَةً، و حُبُّنا أهلَ البَيتِ أفضَلُ عِبادَةٍ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Verily above every act of worship is an even better act of worship, and love for us, the household of the Prophet, is the best act of worship.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن أطاعَ رَجُلاً في مَعصِيَةٍ فقَد عَبَدَهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Worshippers are of three types: people who worship Allah, Mighty and Exalted, out of fear, and that is the worship of a slave; people who worship Allah, Blessed and most High, seeking to be rewarded thereof, and that is the worship of an employee; and people who worship Allah, Mighty and Exalted, out of love for Him, and that is the worship of free men and is the best type of worship.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الجواد (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن أصغى إلى ناطِقٍ فقَد عَبَدَهُ، فإن كانَ النّاطِقُ يُؤَدّي عَنِ اللّهِ عَزَّوجلَّ فقَد عَبَدَ اللّهَ، وإن كانَ النّاطِقُ يُؤَدّي عنِ الشَّيطانِ فقَد عَبَدَ الشَّيطانَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘He who obeys someone in committing an act of disobedience [to Allah] has indeed worshipped him.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أفضَلُ العِبادَةِ الفِقهُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The best form of worship is to gain an understanding [of religion].

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أعظَمُ العِبادَةِ أجراً أخفاها .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The worship deserving of the greatest reward is that which is most discreetly performed.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): العِبادَةُ مَعَ أكلِ الحَرامِ كالبِناءِ عَلَى الرَّملِ ، وقيلَ :عَلَى الماءِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Worship performed while having consumed unlawful food is like a building built on sand. [or on water according to other narrations]

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أفضَلُ العِبادَةِ العَفافُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The best form of worship is self-restraint.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أفضَلُ العِبادَةِ غَلَبَةُ العادَةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The best form of worship is breaking a habit or an addiction.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أفضَلُ العِبادَةِ الزَّهادَةُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The best form of worship is abstinence.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أفضَلُ العِبادَةِ العِلمُ بِاللّهِ والتَّواضُعُ لَهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The best form of worship is coming to know Allah and humbling oneself before Him.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أفضَلُ العِبادَةِ إدمانُ التَّفَكُّرِ في اللّهِ وفي قُدرَتِهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The best form of worship is to be in a state of perpetual reflection about Allah and His power.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): واللّهِ ما عُبِدَ اللّهُ بِشيءٍ أفضَلَ مِن أداءِ حَقِّ المُؤمِنِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘By Allah, there is no better way to worship Allah than to fulfil the right of a fellow believer.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أعبَدُ النّاسِ مَن أقامَ الفَرائضَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The best worshipper among people is he who performs the acts obligatory upon him.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الرِّضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لَيسَتِ العِبادَةُ كَثرَةَ الصِّيامِ وَالصَّلاةِ، وَإنَّما العِبادَةُ كَثرَةُ التَّفَكُّرِ في أمرِ اللّهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Rida (AS) said, ‘Worship is not about fasting or praying much, rather worship is to reflect much on the command of Allah.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الجوادُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أفضَلُ العِبادَةِ الإخلاصُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Jawad (AS) said, ‘The best form of worship is sincerity.

_source.arabic: عيسى (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): بِحقٍّ أقولُ لَكُم: إنَّهُ كَما يَنظُرُ المَريضُ إلى طَيِّبِ الطَّعامِ فلا يَلتَذُّهُ مَعَ ما يَجِدُهُ مِن شِدَّةِ الوَجَعِ، كذلِكَ صاحِبُ الدّنيا لا يَلتَذُّ بِالعِبادَةِ ولا يَجِدُ حَلاوَتَها مَعَ ما يَجِدُ مِن حُبِّ المالِ .
_source.english: Prophet Jesus (AS) said, ‘With truth I tell you that verily just as the sick man can only look at good food but cannot enjoy it due to the intense pain he suffers, similarly the man engrossed in worldly affairs cannot enjoy worship nor taste its sweetness because of the love that he harbours for worldly possessions.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): آفَةُ العِبادَةِ الفَترَةُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The bane of worship is lassitude.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا تُكَرِّهوا إلى أنفُسِكُمُ العِبادَةَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Do not make worship loathsome to yourselves [by forcing it upon yourselves].

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الشَّقِيُّ مَنِ انخَدَعَ لِهَواهُ وغُرُورِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The wretched one is he who lets himself be deceived by his whims and his delusion.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ الشَّقِيَّ مَن حُرِمَ نَفعَ ما اُوتِيَ مِنَ العَقلِ والتَّجرِبَةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily the wretched person is he who is deprived of drawing any benefit from his intellect and the experiences that he has been granted.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): تَوَقَّوُا المَعاصِيَ واحبِسُوا أنفُسَكُم عنها ؛ فإنَّ الشَّقِيَّ مَن أطلَقَ فيها عِنانَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Be on your guard against sins and restrain yourself from them, for verily the wretched one is he who gives himself free rein to them.

_source.chapter: The Wretched One Was Wretched As a Foetus in His Mothers Womb
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): السَّعيدُ مَن سَعِدَ في بَطنِ اُمِّهِ ، والشَّقِيُّ مَن شَقِيَ في بَطنِ اُمِّهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The prosperous one is he who prospered from when he was in his mothers womb, and the wretched one is he who was wretched from when he was in his mothers womb.

_source.chapter: The Wretched One Was Wretched As a Foetus in His Mothers Womb
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ اللّهَ عَزَّوجلَّ خَلَقَ السَّعادَةَ والشَّقاوَةَ قَبلَ أن يَخلُقَ خَلْقَهُ ، فَمَن عَلِمَهُ اللّهُ سَعيداً لَم يُبغِضْهُ أبَداً ، وإن عَمِلَ شَرّاً أبغَضَ عَمَلَهُ ولَم يُبغِضْهُ، وإن كانَ عَلِمَهُ شَقِيّاً لَم يُحِبَّهُ أبداً، وإن عَمِلَ صالحاً أحَبَّ عَمَلَهُ وأبغَضَهُ لِما يَصِيرُ إلَيهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Verily Allah, Mighty and Exalted, created prosperity and wretchedness before He even created His creation. So whoever Allah knows will be prosperous, He will never despise, and even when he commits an evil deed, He will despise the deed but not the person. And if He knows that someone will be wretched, He will never love him, and even when he performs a good deed, He will love the deed but despise the person because of what he is to become.

_source.chapter: The Wretched One Was Wretched As a Foetus in His Mothers Womb
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ اللّهَ تباركَ وتعالى يَنقُلُ العَبدَ مِنَ الشَّقاءِ إلى السَّعادَةِ، ولا يَنقُلُهُ مِن السَّعادةِ إلى الشَّقاءِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Verily Allah, Blessed and most High, may transfer a servant from wretchedness to prosperity, but He never transfers anyone from prosperity to wretchedness.

_source.chapter: The Wretched One Was Wretched As a Foetus in His Mothers Womb
_source.arabic: عن محمّدَ بنِ أبي عُمَيرٍ: سَألتُ أبا الحسنِ موسى بنِ جَعفرٍ عَن معنى قولِ رَسول اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): «الشَّقِيُّ مَن شَقِيَ في بَطنِ اُمِّهِ ، والسَّعيدُ مَن سَعِدَ في بَطنِ اُمِّهِ» ، فقالَ: الشَّقِيُّ مَن عَلِمَ اللّهُ وهُو في بَطنِ اُمِّهِ أنّهُ سَيَعمَلُ أعمالَ الأشقِياءِ ، والسَّعيدُ مَن عَلِمَ اللّهُ وهُو في بَطنِ اُمِّهِ أنّهُ سَيَعمَلُ أعمالَ السُّعَداءِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) was once asked by Ibn Abi ‘Umayr about the Prophet (SAWA)s saying, ‘The prosperous one is he who prospered from when he was in his mothers womb, and the wretched one is he who was wretched from when he was in his mothers womb, to which he replied, ‘The wretched one is he who, from when he was in his mothers womb, Allah knew would commit acts characteristic of wretched people, and the prosperous one is he who, from when he was in his mothers womb, Allah knew would perform acts characteristic of prosperous people.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): سَبَبُ الشَّقاءِ حُبُّ الدُّنيا.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The cause of wretchedness is love of this world.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسينُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في دعاءِ يَومِ عَرَفَةَ ـ: اللّهُمّ اجعَلْني أخشاكَ كَأنّي أراكَ ، وأسعِدْني بتَقواكَ ، ولا تُشقِني بِمَعصِيَتِكَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Husayn (AS) said in his supplication of Arafa, ‘O Allah, make me fear you as if I see you, let me prosper through being conscious of my duty to You, and keep me from becoming wretched as a consequence of Your disobedience.

_source.chapter: The Most Wretched of All People
_source.arabic: عيسى (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أشقَى الناسِ مَن هُو مَعروفٌ عندَ الناسِ بِعِلمِهِ مَجهولٌ بِعَمَلِهِ.
_source.english: Prophet Jesus (AS) said, ‘The most wretched of people is he who is reputed amongst people for his knowledge but not known for his action thereof.

_source.chapter: The Most Wretched of All People
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أشقَى الأشقياءِ مَنِ اجتَمَعَ علَيهِ فَقرُ الدُّنيا وعَذابُ الآخِرَةِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The most wretched of all wretched people is he who faces both poverty in this world as well as punishment in the Hereafter.

_source.chapter: The Most Wretched of All People
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ وقد سُئلَ عن أشقَى الناسِ ـ: مَن باعَ دِينَهُ بِدُنيا غَيرِهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) when asked who the most wretched of all people was, replied, ‘He who sells his Hereafter for someone elses profit in this world.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مِن علاماتِ الشَّقاءِ: جُمُودُ العَينِ ، وقَسوَةُ القَلبِ ، وشِدَّةُ الحِرصِ في طَلَبِ الرِّزقِ ، والإصرارُ على الذَّنبِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Among the symptoms of wretchedness are: a look of apathy in the eyes, hardness of the heart, intense greed in seeking out ones livelihood, and persistence in committing sins.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مِن عَلامةِ الشَّقاءِ غِشُّ الصَّديقِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘One of the symptoms of wretchedness is swindling ones own friend.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مِن علاماتِ الشَّقاءِ الإساءَةُ إلى الأخيارِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Among the symptoms of wretchedness is maltreatment of good people.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إيّاكُم والظُّلمَ؛ فإنّهُ يُخرِبُ قُلوبَكُم.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Beware of wrongdoing for verily it corrupts your hearts.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّه لَيَأتِيَ العَبدُ يَومَ القِيامَةِ وقد سَرَّتهُ حَسَناتُهُ، فَيَجِيءُ الرجُلُ فيقولُ: يا ربِّ ظَلَمَني هَذا، فَيُؤخَذُ مِن حَسَناتِهِ فَيُجعَلُ في حَسَناتِ الذي سَألَهُ، فما يَزالُ كذلكَ حتّى ما يَبقى لَهُ حَسَنةٌ، فإذا جاءَ مَن يَسألُهُ نَظَرَ إلى سَيِّئاتِهِ فَجُعِلَت مَع سيّئاتِ الرَّجُلِ، فلا يَزالُ يُستَوفى مِنهُ حتّى يَدخُلَ النارَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily the servant will come on the Day of Resurrection having performed many good deeds which please him, when a man will come, complaining [to Allah], ‘O Lord, this man has wronged me, whereupon some of his good deeds will be taken and transferred to the good deeds of the plaintiff. The situation will continue thus until finally he will be left with no good deeds, and then the plaintiffs evil deeds will start being transferred to his own evil deeds, and he will continue to pay for them thus until he will enter the Fire.
_source.cited_from: Nihayat al-Bidaya wa al-Nihaya, volume:2, p. 55

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): اتَّقُوا الظُّلمَ؛ فإنّهُ ظُلُماتٌ يَومَ القِيامَةِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Fear wrongdoing, for verily it is a source of darkness on the Day of Resurrection.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الظُّلمُ ألأمُ الرَّذائلِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Wrongdoing is the most painful of all vices.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الظُّلمُ يُزِلُّ القَدَمَ، ويَسلُبُ النِّعَمَ ويُهلِكُ الاُمَمَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Wrongdoing causes feet to slip, snatches away bounties and destroys nations.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في خُطبَةٍ لَهُ يَتَبَرَّأُ مِن الظُّلمِ ـ: واللّهِ لأَن أبِيتَ عَلى حَسَكِ السَّعدانِ مُسَهَّداً، أو اُجَرَّ في الأغلالِ مُصَفَّداً، أحَبُّ إلَيَّ مِن أن ألقَى اللّهَ ورسولَهُ يَومَ القِيامَةِ ظالِماً لِبَعضِ العِبادِ، وغاصِباً لِشَيءٍ مِن الحُطامِ، وكيفَ أظلِمُ أحَداً لِنَفسٍ يُسرِعُ إلى البِلى قُفُولُها، ويَطُولُ في الثَّرى حُلُولُها ؟!
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, seeking immunity from wrongdoing, ‘By Allah, I would rather spend a sleepless night on the thorns of the Saadan tree [a type of prickly tree], or be driven as a prisoner in shackles, than meet Allah and His Messenger on the Day of Resurrection having wronged any servant or having usurped any kind of worldly wealth. How can I wrong anyone for the sake of this soul that is rapidly hastening towards destruction and is to remain under the earth for a long time?

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ أيضا ـ: واللّهِ لو اُعطِيتُ الأقاليمَ السَّبعَةَ بما تَحتَ أفلاكِها، على أن أعصِيَ اللّهَ في نَملَةٍ أسلُبُها جُلْبَ شَعِيرَةٍ ما فَعَلتُهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘By Allah, if I was given all the seven domains with all that exists under its celestial spheres in order that I may disobey Allah to the extent of snatching a single grain of barley from an ant, I would not do it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إيّاكَ والظُّلمَ؛ فَمَن ظَلَمَ كَرُهَت أيّامُهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Beware of wrongdoing, for the living days of one who wrongs others become odious.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لَيسَ شَيءٌ أدعى إلى تَغييرِ نِعمَةِ اللّهِ وتَعجِيلِ نِقْمَتِهِ مِن إقامَةٍ على ظُلمٍ؛ فإنّ اللّهَ سَميعُ دَعوَةِ المُضطَهَدِينَ (المَظلومِينَ)، وهُو للظالِمينَ بِالمِرصادِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Nothing induces the reversal of Allahs bounty or the hastening of His retribution than continuous injustice [to others]; for verily Allah hears the call of the oppressed and lies in wait for the oppressors.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن ظَلَمَ قُصِمَ عُمرُهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The life of one who wrongs others is shattered.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): راكِبُ الظُّلمِ يَكبُو بِهِ مَركَبُهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The one who takes wrongdoing as a mount is thrown off by it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن جارَ أهلَكَهُ جَورُهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The one who tyrannises others is ruined by his own tyranny.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): نهى رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) أن يُؤكَلَ ماتَحمِلُ النَّملَةُ بِفِيها وقَوائمِها .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrated, ‘The Prophet (SAWA) forbade anyone from eating anything that an ant carries in its mouth or holds in its grip.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ألا وإنَّ الظُّلمَ ثلاثةٌ: فَظُلمٌ لا يُغفَرُ، وظُلمٌ لا يُترَكُ، وظُلمٌ مَغفورٌ لا يُطلَبُ، فأمّا الظُّلمُ الذي لا يُغفَرُ فالشِّركُ بِاللّهِ ... وأمّا الظُّلمُ الذي يُغفَرُ فَظُلمُ العَبدِ نفسَهُ عندَ بعضِ الهَناتِ، وأمّا الظُّلمُ الذي لا يُترَكُ فظُلمُ العِبادِ بَعضِهِم بَعضاً.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Know that wrongdoing is of three types: the wrongdoing that is unforgivable, the wrongdoing that cannot be left unaccounted, and the wrongdoing that is forgivable and unquestioned. The wrong that is unforgivable is association of anything with Allah …the wrong that is forgivable is when the servant is unjust to himself and wrongs himself with regard to his faults, and the wrong that cannot be left unaccounted is the wrong that people do unto each other.

_source.chapter: The Most Atrocious Type of Wrong
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): اشتَدَّ غَضَبُ اللّهِ عَلى مَن ظَلَمَ مَن لا يَجِدُ ناصِراً غَيرَ اللّهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The wrath of Allah is indeed severe on one who wrongs somebody that has no one to help him apart from Allah.

_source.chapter: The Most Atrocious Type of Wrong
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ظُلمُ الضَّعيفِ أفحَشُ الظُّلمِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Wronging the weak is the most atrocious type of injustice.

_source.chapter: The Most Atrocious Type of Wrong
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لَمّا سُئلَ: أيُّ ذنبٍ أعجَلُ عُقوبَةً لِصاحِبِهِ ؟ ـ: مَن ظَلَمَ مَن لا ناصِرَ لَهُ إلّا اللّهُ، وجاوَرَ النِّعمَةَ بِالتَّقصيرِ، واستَطالَ بِالبَغيِ على الفَقيرِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) was once asked, ‘Which sin hastens punishment down on its perpetrator the fastest? to which he replied, ‘He who wrongs somebody that has no helper save Allah, he who repays bounties with negligence and laxity, and he who displays arrogant and intimidating behaviour towards the poor.

_source.chapter: The Most Atrocious Type of Wrong
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مِن أفحَشِ الظُّلمِ ظُلمُ الكِرامِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘One of the most atrocious types of injustice is to wrong kind people.

_source.chapter: The Most Atrocious Type of Wrong
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لَمّا حَضَرَ عليَّ بنَ الحُسينِ عليهماالسلام الوَفاةُ ضَمَّني إلى صَدرِهِ، ثُمّ قالَ: يا بُنَيَّ ، اُوصِيكَ بما أوصانِي بهِ أبي (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) حينَ حَضَرَتهُ الوَفاةُ وبما ذَكَرَ أنَّ أباهُ أوصاهُ بهِ ، قالَ: يا بُنَيَّ ، إيّاكَ وظُلمَ مَن لا يَجِدُ علَيكَ ناصِراً إلّا اللّهَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) narrated that when his father, Imam Ali Zayn al-Aabidin (AS) was approaching death, he hugged him close to his chest and said, ‘O my son, I am advising you of the same thing that my father advised me in his will when he was approaching death, and the same thing that he said his father advised him - O my son! Beware of wronging one who has no helper against you but Allah.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنَّ اللّهَ يُمهِلُ الظَّالِمَ حتّى يقولَ: قد أهمَلَنِي! ثُمّ يَأخُذُهُ أخذَةً رابِيَةً، إنّ اللّهَ حَمِدَ نفسَهُ عِندَ هَلاكِ الظّالِمِينَ ، فقالَ: «فَقُطِعَ دَابِرُ القَوْمِ الّذينَ ظَلَمُوا وَالحَمْدُ للّهِ رَبِّ العالَمِينَ».
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily Allah gives such respite to the wrongdoer, until he says [rejoicingly], ‘He [Allah] has indeed forgotten about me! Then Allah seizes him with a terrible seizing. Verily Allah has praised Himself with regard to the way in which He destroys wrongdoers, saying in the Quran: “Thus the wrongdoing ones were rooted out, and all praise belongs to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds” (Quran 6:45).

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أملَى اللّهُ عزّ وجلّ لِفرعَونَ ما بينَ الكَلِمَتَينِ ... أربَعينَ سَنَةً، ثُمّ أخَذَهُ اللّهُ نَكالَ الآخِرَةِ والاُولى، وكانَ بينَ أن قالَ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ لموسى وهارونَ عليهماالسلام: «قد أُجِيبَتْ دَعوَتُكُما» وبينَ أن عَرَّفَهُ اللّهُ تعالى الإجابَةَ أربَعينَ سَنَةً.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘Allah gave Pharaoh a long respite of forty years, between His two addresses to him, then Allah seized him with the punishment of this life and the Hereafter. So forty years passed between the time that Allah said to Prophet Moses (AS) and Prophet Aaron (AS): “Your supplication has already been granted” and between the time He actually showed them the answer to their supplication [i.e. through Pharaohs annihilation].

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الظُّلمُ نَدامَةٌ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Wrongdoing results in regret.
